concepts.def: Welfare measures: school meals (1906), old age pensions (1908), National Insurance (1911) under Asquith and Lloyd George.
Militant women's suffrage movement led by Emmeline Pankhurst from 1903; hunger strikes, Cat and Mouse Act 1913.
Nine-day TUC strike supporting miners against wage cuts; defeated by Baldwin government, weakened union power.
Identified five 'Giant Evils' (want, disease, ignorance, squalor, idleness); blueprint for post-war welfare state.
First female PM; privatised industries, defeated 1984-85 miners' strike, Falklands War 1982.
Peace deal ending Troubles in Northern Ireland; devolved Assembly, decommissioning of paramilitary weapons.
